title: Debug: read the stack

blocks.md:
## The top line is the throw

A stack lists calls from newest to oldest. The first `at step` line is where `throw` ran. Fix `step` so `"east"` is legal and `"up"` still throws.

Print `ok` after a good step. Do not throw on a compass heading.

The fox was told `"east"` and still crashed. The stack’s first `at` line points at `step`, not at the first function in the file.
